description: An agent-to-agent call failed? Pass the `failure` ({code, detail}): an HTTP status (400-504), a JSON-RPC, A2A or MCP error code, or the raw error text (TLS, DNS, connection refused, timeout, schema mismatch). Returns a specific diagnosis, severity, whether and how to retry (attempts, backoff, Retry-After), ordered fix steps, the likely owner, evidence to capture and a receipt. Proposal only; GAIP does not touch the other system. Free, no account, no effect outside GAIP: the call records a receipt in GAIP's history. Inputs must be public and non-personal; calling declares that (data_classification defaults to PUBLIC).

counterparty_id.description: Name or URL of the agent/service. Optional.

protocol.description: Counterparty protocol. Inferred from metadata when omitted, otherwise MCP.

name: gaip_diagnose_integration_failure
title: Diagnose integration failure
